chat.text: Investigate and propose a minimal path to show each dictated request as a refined, structured content card in live Dictate chat. Include the quick-fix worktree reuse/return flow, grouping follow-up ideas under the refined prompt, card type labels, icon/name mentions, yes/no feedback buttons that post a chat reply, existing chat markdown/rendering and storage. Preserve raw transcription and chat history; distinguish dashboard task cards from inline chat cards. Keep agent count and Anthropic usage low; inspect before building.

message.text: Direction from you: while dictating, show the evolving refined prompt more prominently than raw transcription, as a distinct larger card on your side of chat. Keep raw transcript available but secondary; follow-up ideas should extend that same refined request instead of replacing past messages. Distinguish inline chat cards from dashboard task cards.

The target workflow is clearer now: the smart assistant keeps its hands free and refines one persistent prompt artifact using visible, incremental deltas; once ready, it launches a configured mastermind that owns the worktree and receives a link to that artifact. Avoid repeating the full prompt in handoff tool calls.
